name: How Long Before You Can Walk on Refinished Floors? A Redmond Timeline
title-tag: When Can You Walk on Refinished Floors? Redmond Timeline
meta-description: Socks in 2–3 hours, furniture at 48–72, rugs at day 7 — the real walk-on timeline for refinished hardwood in Redmond, for waterborne and oil finishes.
post-summary: September 9, 2026 · Socks the same evening, shoes at 24–48 hours, furniture at 48–72, rugs after a week — the milestone-by-milestone timeline for refinished floors, waterborne vs oil side by side, plus how we sequence occupied Redmond homes so work-from-home keeps working.
